chapter_title: Chương 48: Thông báo vòng chung kết sơ khảo Cuộc thi New Concept đã đến

segments.title: Chương 48: Thông báo vòng chung kết sơ khảo Cuộc thi New Concept đã đến
segments.content:
Monday.

After school in the morning, many of the boarding students didn't rush to the cafeteria, but instead stayed in the classroom to watch News 30.

Right during the monthly exams, Saddam had been captured by the Americans!

They weren't allowed to watch TV then, so now that the exams were over, they had to catch up.

On the TV, footage of the capture was repeatedly shown, along with reports on the Americans' follow-up actions.

Xu Haibo ran over to Chen Guiliang's side, staring at the news and saying, "Hero Chen, do you think Iraq really has weapons of mass destruction?"

"If they really did, they would have used them long ago," Chen Guiliang said.

Zhao Cong from dorm 301, who was very concerned with current affairs, couldn't help but chime in, "It's also possible they're still in the experimental phase. Didn't Powell hold up a vial as a sample?"

Chen Guiliang smiled, "Who knows, it might have just been filled with laundry detergent."

"Hahahaha."

Several students nearby burst into laughter upon hearing this.

"Let's go, let's get some stir-fry. My treat!" Chen Guiliang shouted.

Hearing that someone was treating, the brothers from dorm 302 immediately sprang into action.

Walking on the road, Li Yulin asked, "Hero Chen, have you been taken in by a sugar mama? Your lifestyle has improved a lot lately."

Xie Yang hesitated, feeling incredibly antsy.

He really wanted to spill the beans and show off that Chen Guiliang had made a fortune from running a private server. But he had already promised to keep it a secret and could only keep his mouth shut. It was almost giving him an internal injury.

Xu Haibo followed up with a question, "Hero Chen, is it the big sugar mama or the little sugar mama who's keeping you?"

The big sugar mama was, of course, Bian Guanyue, while the little one referred to Tao Xue.

Both beauties were wealthy and on good terms with Chen Guiliang, which made their roommates green with envy!

Chen Guiliang smiled, "I picked up a few hundred yuan a while back."

"You think we'll believe that?" Li Yulin said.

Li Dongqiang suggested, "Let's give him the Arubarbe treatment again tonight to force a confession!"

Chen Guiliang turned and walked toward the cafeteria. "I'm not treating anymore."

"Don't let him get away!"

"You promised a treat, you can't go back on your word!"

The group of guys quickly grabbed Chen Guiliang, twisting his arms behind his back and escorting him to a small restaurant outside the school.

After eating and drinking their fill, they returned to school to continue doing practice problems.

Tao Xue ran into the classroom, her expression mysterious as she said, "Did you know? Guo Xiaosi is suspected of plagiarism!"

"Really?" Chen Guiliang pretended to be very surprised.

Tao Xue's eyes widened as she started gossiping, "It's absolutely true. It started blowing up last week. I've read 'Never-Flowers in Never-Dream', and yesterday I checked out 'Circle In, Circle Out' on the Tianya forum. The two books have a lot of similarities, and 'Circle In, Circle Out' was serialized earlier."

Chen Guiliang said, "Then it was most likely an 'inspiration'."

"What 'inspiration'? It's blatant plagiarism. I can't believe Guo Xiaosi is that kind of person!" Tao Xue's tone was filled with anger and disappointment.

Chen Guiliang smiled, "Aren't you a fan of his books?"

"I side with reason, not with people I know, okay? Besides, he's not my relative," Tao Xue grew more depressed as she spoke. "I could have gone to the Municipal No. 2 High School. It's only because I liked Guo Xiaosi that I came to the County No. 2 High School to be his schoolmate. I'm so mad, so mad!"

Chen Guiliang consoled her, "But we should thank Guo Xiaosi. It's how we got to know each other. If you didn't admire him, you wouldn't be studying here."

"That's true," Tao Xue paused.

Guo Xiaosi had really hit a brick wall this time. The author he had plagiarized was no small fry, but a returning-from-abroad editor for The Oriental Outlook!

When he chose his target for plagiarism, he probably never expected that the author of a novel with little fame on Tianya would actually have a pretty strong background and connections.

If he had known earlier, Guo Xiaosi would definitely have picked another book to copy.

Haha.

Tao Xue asked, "Great-nephew, what about that cyberpunk novel of yours?"

"I've only written the first chapter," Chen Guiliang said.

Tao Xue was a bit speechless. "You already finished the first chapter half a month ago. How is it still just the first chapter? I'm still waiting to read the rest!"

Chen Guiliang said, "I have to cooperate with your brother and I'm busy with my review and practice problems. Where do I have the time to write a novel?"

"Forget it, the college entrance exam is more important. I'll press you for the manuscript when you're in college." Auntie Tao was quite reasonable after all.

Seeing Chen Guiliang take out a practice worksheet, she proactively waved goodbye, so as not to delay her great-nephew's studies.

Chen Guiliang worked on the worksheet very slowly.

Whenever he encountered a problem he couldn't solve, he would stop to slowly flip through his books, or go ask Xu Haibo for help.

Until he had grasped the knowledge point for that problem.

Whether or not he could finish the practice worksheets given by the teacher was, he felt, secondary. It didn't even matter if he didn't hand in the homework.

Another hour passed, and Bian Guanyue came to the classroom.

She had bought three servings of small potatoes at the school gate. One was for Zheng Feng, who accompanied her to school, one was for Wu Meng, who helped her with her studies, and one was brought specifically for Chen Guiliang.

The little rich girl who was so cold when she first transferred had now learned to get along with her classmates.

Of course, this was limited to those she was more familiar with.

With classmates she didn't know well, Bian Guanyue still didn't like to talk.

Zheng Feng had been happily eating his small potatoes, but when he saw Bian Guanyue bring a serving specially for Chen Guiliang, the potatoes in his mouth instantly lost their flavor.

They were the same small potatoes, but if he weren't present, Bian Guanyue definitely wouldn't have bought any for him.

But if Chen Guiliang weren't present, Bian Guanyue would have specifically brought a serving for him!

"Your great-uncle called. He said the screen for the Apple laptop arrived this morning." Bian Guanyue placed the small potatoes on his desk.

Chen Guiliang picked up a toothpick and ate a piece. "I'll go with you this weekend."

Bian Guanyue said, "Then let's meet at the bus station at nine o'clock on Saturday morning. We'll call each other then."

After speaking, Bian Guanyue returned to her seat to study.

"Not bad, Hero Chen, another date with the class beauty," his deskmate Qin Shanshan teased, mooching a piece of potato as she spoke.

Chen Guiliang asked, "You want to go too?"

"I'm not interested. I've already made plans to go rollerblading this weekend," Qin Shanshan said. "By the way, do you know how to rollerblade? We should go together sometime."

"We'll see when I have time," Chen Guiliang said perfunctorily.

Rollerblading was extremely popular at this time, even considered a fashionable sport in small towns.

In another two years, it would be a different story, and roller rinks would start closing down one after another.

"Class representative, pass out the papers."

Geography teacher Zhong Dahe arrived in the classroom a few minutes early. Without troubling the student on duty, he picked up the eraser and cleaned the blackboard himself.

Besides being a geography teacher, he also held two other positions: vice principal and dean of political education.

He was the next-in-line principal for County No. 2 High School, and it would be under his leadership that the school would surpass Municipal No. 2 High School.

Later, he would also hold a slew of titles like adjunct professor, master's supervisor, and external expert for master's thesis reviews at a certain key university.

"You've all heard, right? Saddam has been captured."

After wiping the blackboard, Zhong Dahe suddenly threw this out.

It turned out he had come to the classroom early today just to shoot the breeze with the students.

"We heard!"

The entire class answered in unison.

He picked up a piece of chalk and casually sketched an outline of the Middle East map. "This place is the crossroads of Asia, Africa, and Europe, and has been a place of constant warfare since ancient times. When you study geography, it's best to combine it with history. Today, we won't go over the monthly exam papers first. Taking the opportunity of Saddam's capture, we'll review the geographical knowledge points of the Fertile Crescent..."

Zhong Dahe's lectures were witty and humorous, and his knowledge was extensive. He drew on a wide range of sources, making his lessons as engaging as listening to a story.

Of course, he also frequently boasted.

One was about his glorious feat of quitting smoking. An old smoker of over twenty years, he quit just like that. He quit that very day and never touched another cigarette since.

The other was about his younger brother who immigrated to the United States, talking about how successful he was.

Occasionally, there were other things he could boast about.

For example, last year, he led an environmental protection project for teenagers, with specific teachers guiding the students. Eight projects won awards nationwide, and No. 2 High School ranked first. Two of the students received their awards in the Great Hall of the People, were met by national leaders, and were both granted admission to prestigious universities.

This damn school had more than just one Guo Xiaosi.

This year's provincial top scorer in the science stream also came from County No. 2 High School. Everyone knew that the 2003 math exam had been leaked, and the backup paper had left students wailing in misery. The score of this student from No. 2 High School was 137.

In a blink of an eye, it was the weekend again.

During the peak hours on Friday and Saturday of this week, "Abyss Legend" still maintained nearly 9,000 concurrent online players.

Quite a few players had been lured away by similar, copycat private servers.

Many new players had joined as well, mainly from internet cafes and readers of Popular Software magazine.

Shanda still hadn't made a move.

But on Thursday, Tao Chenggang called. "Something big has happened. Five national ministries and commissions jointly announced that they will soon launch a special crackdown on private servers and game cheats. The special campaign is set to officially begin on New Year's Day, which is thirteen days from now."

"What's the reaction from our fellow private server operators?" Chen Guiliang asked.

Tao Chenggang said, "They're all scared stiff. A joint operation by five ministries and commissions, that's a huge deal! I heard two of the copycat servers that were making dungeon-based versions have directly canceled their launch plans and are going to lay low for a while. The 17577 forum also received a lawyer's letter from Shanda. The site administrator, Can Ying, doesn't even dare to show his face now."

"What does Brother Gang plan to do?" Chen Guiliang asked.

Tao Chenggang said, "On December 31st, the day before the special operation, we'll take down the game download link and stop all promotion from then on, as a gesture of respect to the officials. I've asked a lawyer. As long as we don't stir up any more trouble, we should be fine."

"Then we'll listen to Brother Gang." Chen Guiliang was still a few months shy of his 18th birthday, so he was still a minor.

Those who made private servers and cheats were truly frightened these past two days.

The name "five ministries and commissions" was intimidating just to hear!

Some of the more timid ones even shut down their private servers directly, not daring to drag it out until the day of the special rectification campaign.

The use of cheats in official games also quieted down a lot. At the very least, no new cheats were emerging.

Shanda also seized the opportunity to build momentum. Zhang Yingfeng, the head of legal and copyright affairs, successively gave interviews to more than ten media outlets, talking at length about Shanda's zero-tolerance policy towards cheats and private servers.

Chen Guiliang hid away in school, turning a deaf ear to all of this.

On Saturday night, Chen Guiliang took a special shower and stood in front of the full-length mirror, choosing his clothes for the next day.

He was going to help Bian Guanyue with her computer again.

"Chen Guiliang from 302, come get the phone!"

The dorm manager stood in the third-floor hallway and shouted.

"Coming, coming." Chen Guiliang dropped his clothes and ran down to the dorm manager's office on the second floor.

The entire dormitory building only had one landline telephone, located in the manager's office.

"Hello, this is Chen Guiliang," Chen Guiliang said.

A female voice came from the phone, "Did you submit a piece for the New Concept Composition Competition?"

"Yes," Chen Guiliang instantly understood what this was about.

"I'm Mengya editor Hu Weishi. I was afraid you might not receive the notification for the second round, so I'm calling in advance to let you know. Your notification letter has been sent out. If you don't receive it, you can check the details for the second round in the first issue of Mengya magazine next year. When the time comes, you can just take a train to participate. We can reimburse you for the train ticket. Only hard seats can be reimbursed."

"Okay, thank you, Editor Hu."

"Haha, you're also from Fushi No. 2 High School. I thought you would call me 'Sister Weishi' like Guo Xiaosi does."

"Thank you, Sister Weishi."

"If you have a full-length novel to submit, you can mail it directly to my office. Make sure to write my name clearly as the recipient. Remember, no plagiarism!"

A-Gui: Sister Weishi, I'm really sorry, everything I write is plagiarized.

"Alright."

"When Guo Xiaosi begged me to serialize 'Never-Flowers in Never-Dream', I asked him time and again if he had plagiarized, to avoid making it a hassle like 'Ice Fantasy'. He kept saying no, and now there's another mess!"

"Understood."

"I'm hanging up now. I still have to notify other contestants."

"Goodbye, Sister Weishi."

"Goodbye."

Chen Guiliang had heard of this female editor, Hu Weishi.

She was the "boss" that Han Han talked about, the one who called him about his makeup exam.

She was the "Sister Weishi" that Guo Xiaosi talked about, at least that's what he called her before they had a falling out.

The various revisions of Mengya magazine were also all from Hu Weishi's hand.
